stories.title: Are the Texans' playoff hopes still alive? How Houston has banded together through tough losses
stories.summary: Houston enters "Thursday Night Football" against Indianapolis with a 32.4% chance of making the playoffs.

stories.title: Why can't Anthony Richardson beat out the struggling Daniel Jones as Colts QB1?
stories.summary: Jones has some of the worst numbers in the NFL, yet Richardson can't get on the field for the woeful Colts.

stories.title: LSU president tells Wade not to play Luis amid eligibility battle
stories.summary: Wade Rousse said his decision -- a day after RJ Luis Jr. made his debut for the LSU men's basketball team -- came "after further review."

stories.title: Rams WR Nacua suspended 3 games, to serve while on IR
stories.summary: Los Angeles Rams standout wide receiver Puka Nacua has been suspended three games for violating the league's personal conduct policy, the NFL announced Thursday.

stories.title: Agents push back against 'fundamentally unfair' SEC standardized player contracts
stories.summary: The SEC's new uniform NIL and revenue sharing agreements are causing an uproar among agents concerned that the contracts are loaded with terms that are unfair.
